title.narrative: Financial Guarantee -Mibanco Colombia - Microcredits for rural sector -2019-2025
Financial Guarantee -Mibanco Colombia - Microcredits for rural sector -2019-2025

description.narrative: Denna insats syftar till att använda lån och garantier som ett instrument för privatsektorsamarbete för rural utveckling
This contribution aims at starting the use of loans and guarantees as instrument for private sector collaboration, directed towards rural development.

This contribution aims to facilitate loans and financial services to micro-, small- and medium-sized rural and urban-based enterprises, women-owned businesses, and targeted beneficiary populations (Colombian victims of the conflict, ex-combatants in the process of reintegration, people with disabilities, Afro Colombian and Indigenous peoples) in rural regions that have been especially affected by armed conflict and thereby have no or little access to financial services.

The last report showed that, by December 31st,2023, the Bank had serviced 12,788 clients through 14,316 loans in 188 of the 258 prioritized municipalities, totalling COP$43.7 billion. The final loan with an ASDI guarantee was disbursed on May 31, 2024.
This guarantee is being evaluated and the final report is expected by February 2026. The inception report of the evaluation contrasted this last report with Mibanco´s data base and showed that Mibanco's loan portfolio is composed of 82% unsecured or unspecified collateral loans. The National Guarantee Fund (FNG) represents 15%, followed by the USAID guarantee at 1.2%. The Sida´s guarantee accounts for 0.4%. The database identifies a total of 11,956 transactions backed by the Sida´s guarantee carried out between 2019 and 2023, representing a cumulative disbursement of 34.523 billion pesos. 2021 had the highest number of recorded loans, with 6,464 transactions associated with 5,684 clients and a total disbursement of over 17.7 billion pesos. The evaluators originally identified discrepancies in the figures that have been clarified and completed by Mibanco. Therefore, the results will be delivered with the final report of the evaluation.
There have been seven claims since the first payment in 2020. Below is a list of each claim, the number of individual claimed loans and date of payment: #1 93 sep 2020 #2 473 may 2022 #3 923 oct 2022 #4 622 abr 2023 #5 247 oct 2023 #6 558 nov 2024 #7 93 jun 2025 The total value for the seven claims paid out was 9 577 375 SEK, an amount subsequently decreased by recovery payments paid in by Mibanco.
